title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
summary: AI agents that interact with enterprise APIs on behalf of users need to maintain user identity throughout the request chain. Without identity propagation, API calls arrive at downstream services as the application itself rather than the user who initiated the action.
